thread:
anya: Quick kickoff — we need to prioritize customer-driven asks for smart routing + fallback policies. PRD skeleton + acceptance criteria needed. cc @sam @kelly
sam: Agreed. Proposal to classify asks: latency SLOs, region constraints/data residency, compatible model variants, and billing/fallback cost rules.
kelly: Example customer ask — EU bank: primary -> on-prem pinned model, fallback -> hosted eu-small-1. Must ensure no cross-region data egress.
dave: Rollout gates suggestion: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100%. Auto-rollback if error-rate > 2% or 95p latency > 500ms.
sam: Draft acceptance criteria:
- API & UI accept tier definitions and region constraints
- Routing evaluation returns explicit fallback_chain and a reason code
- No unencrypted logs or cross-region copies for private deployments
- Integration tests cover model incompatibility and tokenization mismatch
kelly: Edge cases: incompatible model variants (e.g., different tokenizers / vocab). Fallback must include tokenizer compatibility check and a graceful degrade to reranking-only mode.
dave: Perf gates: hot-path P95 < 200ms for hosteds; fallback path P95 < 400ms. Cost ceiling per 1k requests = $X (placeholder until econ team inputs).
sam: Minimal API sketch:
```json
POST /v1/routing/evaluate
{
  "customer_id": "cust-123",
  "preferred_model": "onprem/llama-70b-q4",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "latency_slo_ms": 300
}
```
returns
```json
{ "route": "onprem-pool-1", "fallback_chain": ["eu-hosted-small-1","eu-hosted-xsmall-1"], "reason":"ok" }
```
chris: I'll add unit tests + perf harness (k6) to simulate model OOM and region outage.
deploy-bot: created task PRD-4282 assigned to @anya
anya: Next actions: sam -> API spec by EOW, kelly -> compliance checklist, dave -> rollout plan + automation for rollback. Sync Thurs 11:00. :thumbsup:
